blocks.text: Thin layer chromatography (TLC) mein alumina (Al₂O₃) ya silica (SiO₂) ko paani mein mila kar slurry (gaarha ghol) banaya jata hai, phir usay glass (shishe ki) slide par barabar phaila diya jata hai. Is layer (teh) ko oven mein sukhaya jata hai to slide par safaid solid layer ban jati hai; yahi stationary phase hai. TLC paper chromatography se tez hai.

Slide ke neeche ke qareeb pencil aur ruler se seedhi baseline banayi jati hai. Capillary tube se baseline par sample ka spot (dhabba) lagaya jata hai. Aik hi slide par alag alag jagah aik se zyada samples lagaye ja sakte hain. Solvent chromatography tank mein dala jata hai. Slide ko solvent (mobile phase) mein is tarah duboya jata hai ke baseline solvent level se oopar rahe.

blocks.alt: Baen: tank mein solvent mein khari glass slide, solvent se oopar base line par do sample spots. 'After 10 mins' wala teer daen tank tak jata hai jis par lid (dhakkan) hai: solvent front oopar tak pohncha aur har sample ne slide par mukhtalif heights (unchaiyon) par spots diye. Labels: lid, solvent front, glass slide, base line, solvent.
blocks.caption: Figure 28.4: Thin layer chromatography (kitab ki Figure 28.4 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Sample ke components solvent mein ghulte hain aur aluminium oxide par mukhtalif had tak adsorb hote hain (us ki surface par chipakte hain). Kuch mobile phase mein zyada ghulte hain, aur kuch solid stationary phase par zyada adsorb hote hain. Polar substances polar solid stationary phase ki taraf zyada attract hote (khinchte) hain aur zyada mazbooti se adsorb hote hain, is liye woh stationary phase par aahista oopar jate hain. Doosri taraf non-polar substances non-polar solvent mein zyada ghulte hain aur slide par zyada oopar jate hain. Isi farq se sample ki cheezein alag hoti hain. Jab solvent aik khaas unchai tak charh jaye to slide chromatographic chamber se nikal li jati hai. Solvent front, yani solvent jis sab se oonchi jagah tak pohncha, par nishan lagaya jata hai. Slide dryer se sukhayi jati hai. Mukhtalif rangeen spots ki Rf values nikali jati hain aur unhein standard values se mila kar sample ke components pehchane jate hain. Agar components colourless (be-rang) hon to unhein dekhne ke liye locating agent spray kiya jata hai. Ninhydrin spray colourless amino acids ko purple (jamni) rang deta hai. Kuch colourless cheezein ultra-violet roshni dalne par chamakti hain, aur kuch iodine vapours (bhaap) se brown (bhoori) ho jati hain.

items: TLC na-maloom compounds ki Rf values ko maloom standard values se mila kar unhein pehchanti hai.
TLC se kisi substance ki purity (khalis hona) check ki ja sakti hai.
Reaction kitna aage barha, yani reactants khatam ho rahe hain ya products ban rahe hain, yeh TLC se check hota hai.

Pharmaceutical (dawaiyan banane ki) aur food (khurak ki) industry mein TLC se dawaiyon ki purity, aur khurak mein preservatives (kharab hone se bachane wali cheezein), colourants (rang) aur sweeteners (meethi cheezein) check kiye jate hain.
TLC mitti, paani, khurak aur hawa mein pollutants, pesticides (keere maar dawaiyan) aur toxic (zehreeli) cheezein bhi dhoond sakti hai.
Forensic science mein TLC jurm ki jagah par drugs, dhamake ke baad ka malba (post blast debris), khoon, paseena aur semen pehchanne mein kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab application (v) mein 'TCL' likhti hai; sahi naam TLC (thin layer chromatography) hai.

items: TLC zyada tar qualitative (sirf pehchan wali) technique hai; yeh kisi cheez ki miqdar ka sirf andaza deti hai. Is liye yeh accurate (bilkul theek) quantitative (miqdar napne wali) technique nahi.
Jin compounds ki Rf values qareeb qareeb hon, TLC unhein saaf alag nahi kar sakti. Is liye spots ki resolution (saaf alag hona) hamesha achhi nahi hoti.
TLC mein sample ki sirf thori miqdar lagayi aur jaanchi ja sakti hai; bari miqdar alag karne ke liye yeh suitable (munasib) nahi.
Yeh technique humidity (nami), temperature aur kaam ki jagah ki safai se affect hoti hai, is liye dobara karne par wahi nateeja (reproducibility) kam milta hai.

blocks.prompt: (a) Aik mixture mein butanone aur pentane hain. Aluminium oxide ko stationary phase aur benzene ko solvent bana kar TLC se inhein kaise alag karenge?
blocks.explanation: Mixture ka spot baseline par laga kar slide ko benzene mein rakhein. Butanone polar hai (C=O group), is liye polar aluminium oxide par zyada chipakta hai aur kam oopar jata hai (kam Rf). Pentane non-polar hai, benzene mein zyada ghulta hai aur zyada oopar jata hai (zyada Rf). Yun do alag spots bante hain, jo iodine ki bhaap ya UV roshni se dekhe ja sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: (b) TLC mein substance X ki Rf value substance Y se zyada hai. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: X mobile phase (solvent) mein zyada ghulta hai aur/ya stationary phase par Y se kam chipakta hai (maslan X kam polar hai), is liye solvent ke saath zyada oopar jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baalon ke teen rangon (hair dyes) ka chromatogram. Rang A plate par neeche aik dhabba deta hai, rang B oopar aik dhabba, aur rang C do dhabbe, aik A ki unchai par aur aik B ki unchai par.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 28.1(c): Baalon ke rangon A, B aur C ka chromatogram (Quick Check 28.1 mein chhape chromatogram ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.prompt: (c) Baalon ke rangon (hair dyes) A, B aur C ke chromatogram se teen conclusions (nataij) batayein.
blocks.explanation: A aur B dono ka sirf aik aik dhabba hai, is liye har aik mein aik hi rang hai. C ke do dhabbe hain, is liye C mixture hai. C ke dhabbe A aur B ke dhabbon ki unchai par hain (Rf values wahi), is liye C mein A aur B dono rang hain. (B ki Rf zyada hai, is liye B solvent mein A se zyada ghulta hai.)

items: TLC: slide par alumina ya silica ki teh (stationary), solvent (mobile); paper chromatography se tez.
Polar cheezein polar aluminium oxide par zyada chipakti hain aur aahista chalti hain; non-polar zyada oopar jati hain.
Colourless spots ninhydrin, UV roshni ya iodine ki bhaap se nazar aate hain.
Istemal: pehchan, purity, reaction ki progress, dawa aur khurak, pollution, forensics; limitations: zyada tar qualitative, qareebi Rf wale compounds alag nahi hote.
